summary: Cross-process write-safety fixes from the multiwriter soak: exclusive-create (O_EXCL) for all file pre-creates, BEGIN IMMEDIATE around every sqlite read-modify-write, and lock retry budget (~24s) raised past the stale threshold (10s)
context: The W2.2 acceptance soak (real processes, SIGKILL mid-stream, ack-after-commit audit) found three real lost-update/lockout bugs on its first runs.
rationale: check-then-write pre-creates raced across processes and clobbered committed data; WAL serializes statements but not read-modify-write pairs; waiters gave up (ELOCKED) before proper-lockfile's stale window allowed stealing a dead process's lock.
